title: Topology, canary promotion and rollback are fixed institutional deployment evidence
summary: Publication does not imply global deployment. Exact reviewed policy versions are routed by explicit service/region/channel/tenant/cohort bindings. Progressive overlap, canary promotion gates, post-promotion health gates and rollback select exact reviewed artifacts using fixed criteria.
invariants: Publishing vNext does not make it operative.
Deployment topology selects which reviewed policy may execute; topology is not customer-risk evidence.
Canary promotion and automatic rollback criteria are fixed/reviewable, not runtime LLM judgements.
Rollback returns to the exact prior reviewed artifact rather than synthesizing a new policy.

provenance.claim: Institutional Policy v0.8 contains topology, progressive rollout, evidence-gated promotion and post-promotion rollback mechanics.
Security documentation preserves rollout metrics as deployment evidence outside customer SecuritySnapshot.
